title: Indian-Style Roasted Nectarine and Patatas
description: A sweet and savory fusion of Indian and Spanish flavors, combining roasted nectarines and patatas with a hint of bravas spice.
instructions: Cut the nectarines in half and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garam masala, cumin powder, and bravas spice mix.
Toss to coat and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the nectarines are tender.
While the nectarines are roasting, slice the patatas into thin rounds.
Place the patatas on a separate baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
Season with salt and roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy.
Once the nectarines are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the roasted nectarines with the crispy patatas and a sprinkle of sugar.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves, if desired.
